title: OpenSSL-dependent tests panic when openssl binary absent
description: smime_tests.rs tests C and D (test_sign_output_accepted_by_openssl, test_encrypt_output_decrypted_by_openssl) call Command::new('openssl').output().expect('openssl must be available'). On a CI machine without openssl in PATH (common in minimal Docker images) the tests panic rather than being skipped. The maintenance consequence: contributors running cargo test in a fresh environment see a panic with no clear guidance on the missing dependency. The fix is to check if openssl is available (e.g. Command::new('openssl').arg('version').status().is_ok()) and use eprintln\!/panic with a clear skip message, or use the standard skip pattern.
